column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST: a registeredBackends test, so it runs one subtest per dialect and mysql and mssql skip in these PostgreSQL-only jobs while postgres RUNS -- two, not three. Measured by name with only CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set: go test ./engine/ -run TestConcurrentStartsUnderOneKeyAllGetAnAnswer -count=1 -json reports exactly /mysql and /mssql. Guards cleat#1753, and it has to run on all three because the two defects it caught are DIFFERENT per dialect and neither is reachable from the other: MySQL deadlocked (1213) because InnoDB gap-locks the range a non-matching DELETE scans, while SQL Server violated its primary key (2627) because INSERT...WHERE NOT EXISTS is not atomic at READ COMMITTED. PostgreSQL has neither and passed throughout -- so a postgres-only run vouches for nothing here, and a single-dialect version of this test would have found neither bug.
